public_body: Three Rivers Fire District Prudential Committee
overall: The AG found the committee violated the Open Meeting Law by holding a June 10 executive session on discipline of the fire chief without notice to him or his related rights, but deemed its July 13 repudiation vote and rescheduled session appropriate remedial action, and ordered release of unredacted minutes.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleged the committee held an illegal June 10 executive session on discipline of the fire chief, who was not given notice or his executive session rights.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee held an executive session without affording Mr. Turner with the rights guaranteed to him by the Open Meeting Law, the Committee violated the Law.

remedy: Provide the complainant, the fire chief, with an unredacted copy of the June 10 executive session minutes within ten days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: In addition to the action already taken, we order the Committee to provide Mr. Turner with an unredacted copy of the June 10 executive session minutes.
